name: a completely normal dating simulation that is definitely completely sweet, innocent and normal
source:
a fun dating sim where you get to date stick figures! but... is that all it is? i doubt it. why don't you find out? find out just how much more there is in this game than simply a fun dating sim where you get to date stick figures? spoiler: there is also a baguette

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款有趣的恋爱模拟游戏，你可以和火柴人约会！但……真的只有这些吗？我可不这么觉得。不妨亲自一探究竟，看看这款游戏除了和火柴人约会，还有多少内容。剧透一下：游戏里还有法棍。
